subject.title: fix: make Back work within channel setup

question: Should channel setup formally use `beforePersistentEffect` as the contract that ends replayable Back navigation for every plugin adapter, including the retained accepted-plugin-install path?
rationale: This determines the durable-effect and rollback semantics of a shared setup API; code review cannot safely choose that cross-plugin compatibility contract without owner intent.

options.title: Adopt the explicit boundary
options.body: Approve the callback as the required adapter contract, remove the release-owned changelog edit, and require focused sibling-adapter coverage before merge.

options.title: Use a different shared contract
options.body: Pause this PR and redesign the navigator or adapter interface so durable-effect boundaries are enforced without relying on each adapter to opt in.

recommendation.title: Adopt the explicit boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the callback as the required adapter contract, remove the release-owned changelog edit, and require focused sibling-adapter coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This member is the only setup-contract contributor identified by the provided history; a broader setup-area owner should join if repository ownership differs.
